# scroll-craft engine

Copied unchanged from https://github.com/nateherkai/scroll-craft (commit 75d81f7, "version": "0.3.1"), MIT licence.
The engine is never edited per project: theme it with the --sc-* tokens in src/styles/global.css
and put bespoke behaviour in the page. The script itself is served from public/scrollcraft/scrollcraft.js.

To update: copy engine/scrollcraft.js and engine/scrollcraft.css from a newer release over these two files.
